dedupe_keys.name: wody isok gov pl flood hazard datasets

description: wody.isok.gov.pl: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geoportal Poland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wody.isok.gov.pl. Coverage: the area served by wody.isok.gov.pl. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Wstępna ocena ryzyka powodziowego (WORP); Mapy Zagrożenia Powodziowego i Mapy Ryzyka Powodziowego (MZP i MRP); Usługa przeglądania INSPIRE danych Map Zagrożenia Powodziowego i Mapy ; Usługa pobierania INSPIRE danych Map Zagrożenia Powodziowego i Mapy Ry. Formats seen: WMS, WFS, ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-pl.
